g.title: publication
g.text: Activity and state labels · no in-place promotion of an immutable blocked draft

g.text: Validate current rules, calendar, delivery, teachers,
venue, roster, access, capacity and conflicts

g.text: Retain findings; save corrected NEW version

g.text: Unticked declarations + bounded reason + fresh password

g.text: Prior publication preserved; no partial success

intersected with own active attempt / enrolled courses

g.title: r
g.text: returns exact receipt; altered reuse is refused

g.title: q
